Selected candidates will be employees of the Grama Panchayat and not Government servants. No correspondence will be entertained regarding the payment of fees.

content_sections.heading: Zilla Panchayat Raichur Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The minimum age of applicants must be 18 years as on the application closing date, and candidates must not exceed the maximum age limit prescribed for their category.

content_sections.heading: Zilla Panchayat Raichur Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The vacancy break-up for both posts is given below: Both notifications also list a village/Grama-Panchayat-wise and reservation-category-wise allotment of posts (covering categories such as General, Category-1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B, SC, ST, and reservations for women, rural candidates, Kannada-medium candidates, ex-servicemen, and persons with disabilities). Candidates can refer to the official notification PDF on the ZP Raichur website for the exact village and category allotted to each vacancy number, as this level of detail is not repeated here for readability.

content_sections.heading: Zilla Panchayat Raichur Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The educational qualification is common for both the Clerk-cum-Data Entry Operator and Tax Collector posts: Must have passed PUC or an examination considered equivalent, with Kannada as one of the subjects studied. Must hold a minimum 3-month computer training course certificate from an institution recognized by the Central or State Government. The notification also clarifies that the following are treated as equivalent to PUC: a CBSE/ICSE Class 12 pass, a Class 12 pass conducted by another state's board, a higher secondary certificate from the National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS), a two-year ITI course combined with an NIOS pass in one language and one subject, or a pre-degree examination pass in one language and one subject. Minimum age for all categories is 18 years. Age is reckoned as on the application closing date, 03.09.2026. Both notifications specify that only candidates who reside in the villages under the specific Grama Panchayat where the vacancy exists are eligible to apply for that vacancy in Raichur district; applications from candidates of other districts, taluks, or villages will not be considered. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Zilla Panchayat Raichur Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates must deposit the fee at any State Bank of India (SBI) branch using a challan against the account below, and upload the payment receipt while submitting the online application. The fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstance, including rejection of the application, and will not be adjusted against any other examination or recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Zilla Panchayat Raichur Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for both posts will be made purely on merit, based on the marks obtained by the candidate in the qualifying educational examination (PUC or its recognized equivalent). No separate written examination or interview is mentioned in the provided notification. A provisional merit list will be published, and objections/claims regarding merit can be raised within the specified time, after which the final merit list will be published.

content_sections.heading: Zilla Panchayat Raichur Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready for upload at the time of online application: Mark sheet/certificate of the qualifying educational qualification (PUC or equivalent) Date of birth proof (SSLC marks card or equivalent) Computer training course certificate (minimum 3 months, recognized institution) Caste and category certificate, where applicable (issued by the Tahsildar in the prescribed format) Rural reservation certificate, where claimed (in Format-2, verified by the concerned Block Education Officer) Kannada-medium study certificate, where claimed (verified by the school headmaster) Ex-servicemen certificate / dependent certificate, where applicable Disability certificate, where claiming benefit under the special category (persons with disability) Widow certificate, where applicable Fee payment receipt

faq.question: Q1. What is Zilla Panchayat Raichur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by Zilla Panchayat, Raichur to fill 65 vacant Grama Panchayat posts across Raichur district — 34 posts of Clerk-cum-Data Entry Operator and 31 posts of Tax Collector (Karavasoolegara).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ZP Raichur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 65 vacancies are available — 34 for Clerk-cum-Data Entry Operator and 31 for Tax Collector.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ZP Raichur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application last date is 03.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed PUC or an equivalent examination with Kannada as one subject, and hold a minimum 3-month computer training certificate from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ZP Raichur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years for general category, 43 years for Category-2A/2B/3A/3B, and 45 years for SC/ST/Category-1 candidates, with applicable relaxations for ex-servicemen, special category, and widow candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ZP Raichur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500 for general category, Rs. 300 for other backward categories, Rs. 200 for SC/ST/Category-1/ex-servicemen, and Rs. 100 for special category (persons with disability) candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for ZP Raichur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official Zilla Panchayat Raichur website before the last date.
